settings.title: It arrives
settings.text: Your [nights] nights start the day it's delivered. Put it where they already sleep, with a blanket that smells of home on top.

settings.title: Give them time
settings.text: Night one isn't the verdict. Some dogs claim it at once; some take a fortnight.

settings.title: Not right? Tell us
settings.text: Get in touch with your order number. We arrange free collection from UK mainland addresses and refund in full.

settings.heading: Try it for [nights] nights. At our risk, not yours.
settings.lede: You can't ask a dog in a showroom, and not every dog gives a verdict on the first night. A hundred nights is longer than a whole winter.

settings.title: You order
settings.text: A few taps on a secure checkout.

settings.title: Your trial starts
settings.text: Not right? We collect it free, slept on, hair and all.

settings.heading: The only opinion that counts is your dog's.
settings.lede: Four questions, and we'll point you to the bed they're most likely to keep.
